model_checks.independence: Independent RHS and integrator; same assumed physical model

extension_checks.what: Two original coarse-grid candidate checks retained in extended.json; these do not certify the selected scheduled policy.

constant_continuous_envelope.scope: Independent RHS/RK45 replay of unchanged constant policy, conditional floating-point derivative envelope; not interval or empirical certification

scope: Scenario heat-network validation with literature-anchored ranges; independent numerical checks of selected policies, not calibrated physical accuracy or a global spatial optimum. No bath experiment or award prediction.

template_review.summary_hierarchy: Three-column problem/summary/control-number block precedes title and abstract
template_review.year_handling: Year omitted for historical demo: official current sample comment says 2027 but visible heading says 2026
template_review.numbering: Every page includes control number and Page x of total, including summary; explicit current rule preferred over empty-header sample

publication_scope: Curated historical case; report, reproduction sources and presentation assets only

extended_analysis.schedules: 3-, 6- and 12-segment piecewise-constant, multi-start SLSQP with constraints checked every 5 s, local optima
extended_analysis.execution_tolerance: uniform scaling, 200 random 10%/20% segment errors, one-segment +/-20%, buffer price at 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 C on 6 segments
extended_analysis.mesh_check: Independent three-grid RK45 replay of best + buffered candidates, switch restarts and adaptive continuous envelopes; least-water accepted candidate selected; failed candidates retained.
extended_analysis.jet_zone: ceiling and spread apply outside a 0.15 m radius around the inlet cell; the floor applies to every cell

independent_audit.finding: Unbuffered 12-stage candidate exceeds the spread limit on the finest grid and is rejected. Buffered six-stage 21.48 L policy passes all three networks with strict continuous limits; finite-search, jet-zone, abstract and user-guide claims corrected.
independent_audit.other_changes: Independent validation receipts include input/source hashes; report builder rejects stale schedule evidence.

float_callout_review.method: Numbered LaTeX references plus explanations at their associated arguments; PDF text heuristic checks presence, not semantic support.

test_suite.scope: Full local pytest suite; no expensive demo optimization rerun

structural_replay.scope: Fixed archived-policy replay on one spatial mesh; time-resolution and energy checks only. Sampled acceptance is not continuous or empirical certification; no re-optimization, no claim that the old energy lower bound applies to the finite-body alternatives.

incremental_revision.changes: Recurring abstract/geometry/flow/structural/tap-error values derived from existing evidence; wrong policy-to-perturbation join rejected. No new model run or claim of physical/award validation.
incremental_revision.remaining_manual_scope: Assumption rationale and fixed search-design descriptions still require semantic review when model or experiment design changes; generated values do not automate scientific interpretation.

layout_revision.plot_revision: No silent decimation; rebuilt with archived numerical evidence, all pages pixel-identical to the layout revision
